state: Change the documented numeric exit code in one CLI help example to match the existing implementation; do not change executable behavior.
Fix one CLI subcommand that returns success after a malformed input. Return the established parse-error code and add subprocess tests for valid and invalid inputs.

Redesign exit-code propagation across a supervisor and parallel child commands. Preserve cancellation semantics, partial-result recovery and shell compatibility when children fail in different orders.
Rename the cache eviction counter label in a dashboard example; the counter implementation and behavior are already correct.
Implement a bounded LRU cache in one package with deterministic tests for replacement, reads and capacity limits. There is no concurrent access.
Diagnose stale cache entries across replicated writers and design eviction that preserves read-your-writes during partitions and retry storms. Establish invariants and failure-injection tests.
Correct a timezone abbreviation in the README screenshot caption without changing dates or parsing code.
Add an explicit timezone option to one CSV export function using the existing time library. Test daylight-saving transitions and preserve the default behavior.
Repair inconsistent historical timestamps across services after a timezone migration while preserving audit ordering. Plan reversible data repair, ambiguity handling and cross-service validation.
Update an expired sample certificate filename in setup documentation to the replacement file already checked into test fixtures.
Add a configurable CA bundle path to an HTTP client constructor and test trusted, missing and rejected certificate cases using local fixtures.
Design zero-downtime trust-root rotation across mutually authenticated services with staggered deployments, rollback and compromised-key revocation. Analyze trust overlap and failure modes.
Fix the spelling of the pagination argument in a command example to match the existing help output.
Implement keyset pagination for a single table with an existing unique ordered key; add tests for empty pages and duplicate sort values.
Redesign pagination over a changing federated dataset while preserving snapshot consistency, access checks and replay resistance across deployments. Specify token compatibility and recovery.
Change the displayed webhook retry count in a configuration example to match the already-correct default.
Add bounded exponential backoff with injected clock to a single webhook sender and test retryable status codes and cancellation.
Investigate duplicate side effects after failover in a multi-region webhook pipeline. Design idempotency and delivery guarantees with transactional boundaries and fault-injection evidence.
Correct the prose describing an optional schema field; the schema and all tests already reflect the intended default.
Add a default to one optional configuration field and update its parser plus backward-compatibility unit tests.
Migrate a shared schema across independently deployed producers and consumers without breaking old messages. Analyze default interpretation, rollback, replayed events and partial rollout states.
Replace a misleading ZIP extraction example in the guide with the already-supported command; no extraction code changes.
Fix path traversal in one archive extraction helper by enforcing a destination boundary, with tests for absolute paths, dot segments and symlinks.
Design secure extraction of nested untrusted archives used by parallel build workers, covering resource exhaustion, symlink races, sandbox boundaries and adversarial failure recovery.
Fix a unit typo in a rate-limit settings table, changing milliseconds to seconds to match existing code.
Implement a per-process sliding-window rate limiter with an injected clock and deterministic boundary tests; callers are serialized.
Design fair multi-tenant rate limiting across regions under clock skew and outages, including capacity borrowing, isolation guarantees and bounded overshoot.
Rename one feature-flag description in a public example; the flag key and evaluation logic remain unchanged.
Add a deterministic percentage rollout helper using an existing hash function, with tests for stable user buckets and endpoints.
Repair inconsistent rollout decisions across services with cached policies and migrating identifiers. Design reproducible bucketing, compatibility, rollback and audit reconstruction.
Correct a filename glob in the watcher documentation to match the tested example already in the repository.
Add debouncing to one file watcher using an injected clock and test create, update and delete event bursts on one process.
Diagnose missed rebuilds in a concurrent dependency graph under rename storms. Redesign watcher reconciliation and incremental invalidation while preserving determinism and recovery after overflow.
Correct the currency symbol in a billing example without modifying arithmetic or stored amounts.
Replace binary floating-point addition in one invoice subtotal helper with the existing decimal type and add rounding-boundary tests.
Reconcile historical ledger discrepancies caused by mixed rounding policies across currencies and services. Plan a reversible migration preserving audit trails and accounting invariants.
